notes.title: ROOST - Key Art
notes.notes:
Beyond excited to reveal the official key-art for ROOST - created by the talented Ollie Jones.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160135/d92214dc82f076aed122756a03f993fc4935448d.png[/img]

Ollie is a painter from Edinburgh, Scotland who specialises in painting (in their own words), "mundane scenes of drama, mystery and sometimes just people hanging out."

I've been a fan of theirs for a while now, and knew that I had to reach out to see if they'd be interested in bringing ROOST to life in painting form.

Their style perfectly capsulates the vibe and setting of the game, and I couldn't be happier with their contribution.


Check out more of their work here:

https://www.instagram.com/olliemnjones/

notes.title: ROOST | Announcement Trailer
notes.notes:
[i][b]Welcome to your happy place.[/b][/i]

What a great couple of weeks it has been. Never in my wildest dreams did I expect to land anywhere near the level of traction that I'd managed to land with ROOST taking it's first proper steps out into the wild.

[i]Trailer[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1DxsCYqzENY

Not only did ROOST get featured on [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/horror/my-favorite-part-of-this-stunning-ps1-style-indie-inspired-by-silent-hill-and-pt-isnt-that-it-takes-after-the-all-time-horror-greats-its-that-it-only-lasts-as-long-as-a-movie/]GamesRadar[/url], [url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3827921/atmospheric-horror-exploration-title-roost-channels-silent-hill-into-northern-england-trailer/]BloodyDisgusting[/url], [url=https://80.lv/articles/explore-a-foggy-town-in-this-game-inspired-by-silent-hill-pt/]80.LVL[/url] & [url=https://www.gamespark.jp/article/2024/08/24/144442.html]Game*Spark[/url] BUT it also managed to surpass 2,000 Wishlists on Steam!

Thank you for everyone who has liked, shared, commented, wishlisted. It means the world to me.

We're just getting warmed up.

More soon.

JC
